reviews.text:
As a first time visitor to My Animal Clinic I was immediately impressed with the clinic’s cleanliness and esthetics.  I was greeted warmly by the front desk personnel and with no waiting time, (arrived on time for appointment) was taken to the examination room where Oscar and I waited for Dr. Fournier.

Dr. Fournier was friendly, gentle and kind to Oscar.  I was very impressed with her multiple questions in order to get a better understanding as to what Oscar’s treatment would entail.  After this Dr. Fournier gave me the opportunity to ask any questions that I might have which really helped to clear any concerns I had.

At the end of the appointment I was helped out by her cat food nutritionist to select the proper food for Oscar.  Was thrilled that I was able to purchase at the clinic so I could start Oscar on his new food.

Finally, I highly recommend My Animal Veterinary Clinic.  I am so happy that Oscar and I have become part of My Animal Clinic family!
Thank you so much for the 5-star review! We truly appreciate your support and are grateful for the opportunity to care for you and your kitty 🐱. It means a lot to all of us at My Animal Vet! ❤️ …

I had a disappointing experience at this veterinary clinic. During the appointment, I clearly explained my concerns and what I wanted for my pet, but I felt that the veterinarian did not really listen to my requests.

After my pet received the vaccination, no one explained any aftercare instructions, possible side effects, or what symptoms I should watch for. I had to leave without knowing what was considered normal after the vaccine or when I should be concerned.

For a veterinary clinic, clear communication and proper aftercare guidance are very important. Unfortunately, I did not feel that my concerns were taken seriously, and the overall communication was poor.

The staff were very caring, compassionate and professional. I would highly recommend My Animal Veterinary Clinic. We are so grateful for the wonderful care our dear cat received. Thank you everyone at the clinic!
The staff at MAVC are amazing! My cat Zelda was so deeply cared for. The vets Dr. Fournier and Dr. Hoffman are both incredible- they communicate clearly and honestly. 10/10!
Thank you very much for taking the time to post this review. We truly appreciate it  <3

Amazing clinic with an incredibly kind and knowledgeable team. Dr. Hoffman and the staff have been thorough, compassionate, and always take the time to answer all my questions. I feel confident trusting them with Binks’ care. Highly recommend!
This clinic is wonderful. They saw my cat last minute when I was desperate to have him evaluated. He wasn’t even a patient there. They were very kind and the receptionist was so lovely.
An exceptional team who all go above and beyond.

Dr Hoffman is an incredible veterinarian! She really listened and was able to address all of our concerns. Our dogs were very comfortable from minute 1! The office is very welcoming and Marianna at the desk is super friendly and knowledgable!

I took my dog Coco to My Animal Vet Clinic in March 2025 for his annual vaccines, blood work, and to start investigating some allergy concerns. Our first visit went smoothly, and we left feeling positive.

Unfortunately, our second visit was a completely different experience.

As we entered the clinic, another dog and its owner were standing right near the entrance. That dog barked and lunged at Coco, and Coco reacted. In that moment, two staff members immediately grabbed Coco—by the leash and then his collar—and YANKED him away toward a room while I was still holding onto him. This happened multiple times. Nothing was done to address the other dog, all eyes were on me and Coco.

The situation was stressful and upsetting. Coco was shaken, and so was I. What made it worse was the complete lack of acknowledgment—no apology, no reassurance, and no attempt to manage the other dog or create a safer environment.

When the vet came in the room, I expressed how uncomfortable and disappointed I felt. I also questioned why the response was directed solely at my dog. As the only person of colour in the room, I couldn’t ignore how this felt in that moment. Instead of addressing my concerns, I was simply asked if I wanted to reschedule.

I left feeling extremely frustrated and upset.

Later, I had a phone call with Dr. Fournier hoping for some accountability or at least a discussion of their safety protocols. Her response gave me the impression that the incident wasn't taken as seriously as it affected us. When I asked to see the security footage so I could show my husband, I was initially told it would be sent to my email. However, she emailed and asked us to come in to view it in person because they claimed it couldn’t be shared. That didn’t sit right with me, especially given how easily that could have been handled differently. I did not respond.

After that experience, I chose not to return. There was no follow-up from the clinic.

After reading other reviews, it’s concerning to see similar patterns—lack of accountability, poor handling of incidents, and no effort to repair trust with clients.

Given that we spent close to $1000 during the first appointment, it’s unacceptable that we were left with no follow-up and completely brushed off. This was, by far, the worst level of service, professionalism, and basic empathy we’ve ever experienced at a veterinary clinic.

We highly do not recommend this clinic.

Last week I took my cat to My Animal Veterinary Clinic since he was throwing up and has lots of ear wax. The care provided was extraordinary! Everyone was so friendly and knowledgeable, and most importantly, they were so gentil and careful with my very shy, scared boy! They even called to follow up on his health after the appointment! My cat is now doing very well and I know where I will be going from now on.

It was my first visit to My Animal Vet Clinic and the experience was very good. The team was friendly, professional, and attentive from the moment we arrived. Dr. Hoffman provided clear guidance and walked me through the care options for my pet. The clinic has a positive atmosphere, and I felt my pet was in very good hands.
These fine people really look after and care about our pets. Note they have honest pricing, something you don't see in chain or private equity run businesses.

We have been with My Animal Vet for over three years, and have had an incredible experience. Dr. Fournier and her team provide exceptional care, are very responsive and kind with our two dogs. We tend to be frequent flyers with emergency visits and a few health issues that have popped up, and they have provided incredible care. The team at the clinic treat our pets like family, which feels so different than most city clinics. High recommend!
Highly recommend this clinic. Marianna always greets you with a smile and treat for the fur babies. An overall positive experience!
This is a fantastic veterinary clinic. Wonderful staff, very caring and excellent at what they do. Highly recommended!

We take our dog here & absolutely LOVE the team. Nicest people ever and have taken such amazing care of our puppy. They are super responsive and knowledgeable. Every single time my dog enters the building, she is sooo happy to see her vet & the entire team. Cannot recommend them enough!
Thanks so much for the review, Lorne!
We are grateful for your wonderful review!

I had a bizarre experience at this vet office, DO NOT BRING LARGE DOGS HERE. I went in for vaccines and sample of a small lump on my 55lb dog.

They told me they needed to bring her to the back for the sample, which they would do the vaccines while they had her there. I communicated that she can be skittish with painful procedures and does best with me. They stressed that it is necessary to do in the back. I obliged, but mentioned some things:

My dog is immensely food motivated, responsive to sweet talking and gentle handling. I emphasized that I will help if she begins to feel discomfort, please stop and let me know if she is uncomfortable and we can figure out a stress-free plan.

I sat in the lobby and began to hear struggling, banging on the door, nails on the floor, my dog beginning to vocalize in discomfort. From the beginning the vet seemed nervous with the size or breed of my dog.

The three ladies tried to restrain my dog, which only caused further fear and discomfort, and lead to a tech and the vet getting hurt with her thrashing trying to get away. At no point did any one of them communicate what was going on behind the door or ask me to assist with calming her, giving treats, holding her.

My dog came out with blood all over the bump, from several scratches and punctures, as well as a bloody hole in her neck from where im assuming someone was roughly tightening her pinch collar to restrain (NOT APPROPRIATE)

They suggested the highest dose of gabapentin, which never in the 8.5 years of her life has she ever had to be sedated for any medical exam, vaccine, draws, all done in front of me, feeding her treats and gently holding her in place for the vet and assistants. My very sweet, friendly dog was shaking, panicking and nearly dragged me to the car after I paid for a physical exam (only her heart was check, no body condition, teeth, eyes, ears, nothing else) what an absolute rip off. I just wanted to get her home.

Brush up on your handling skills, don't leave the owner of the animal under your care out of the loop, and certainly don't leave them to hear their animal screaming in pain from the lobby only to bring her out bleeding and terrified. Ethical practices go a long way, the complete lack of situational awareness and communication is astounding.

Absolutely careless vet.
Avoid this place at all costs.

Have had such a wonderful experience with My Animal bringing my cat Dubu here throughout her healthy and sick years until we had to put her down recently. My cat was very comfortable with everyone in the clinic and it was always a peaceful and welcoming environment for us. We received such great care throughout her life, and the staff have been so wonderful being there for us throughout all of it! Highly recommend this amazing clinic and team.

Many thanks to Dr Fournier, Dr Hoffman, Marianna, Steph, and Amanda for your amazing care and kindness throughout all the years 💕🐾

My dog absolutely loves it here! He’s always so happy and excited to see the vets and the team every time we visit. I can’t say enough good things about this place. they take such great care of Leo and always give helpful advice on his training and overall well-being.

I think the people that are working here have short-term memory loss because I called in one hour beforehand to check that they had a certain wet food and they told me they did. When I got there, they said you must’ve called somebody else we don’t have it. I showed them the phone number that I had called which was their phone number and they still acted as if I had called somebody else. Terrible place - stick with the Mount Pleasant vet closer to Eglinton if you’re thinking of switching.

Our dog Georgie is a pug with complex medical needs. After a disturbing and stressful experience at a previous veterinary clinic in the neighbourhood where he was left with permanent esophageal strictures following a routine dental cleaning, we have been extremely cautious about who we trust with his care. I have made all of Georgie’s food for the past five years because he cannot swallow properly.

In early 2024 we began going to My Animal Vet Clinic, and it has been one of the best decisions we have ever made for Georgie.

Dr. Fournier and Steph are exceptional. They take extraordinary care of Georgie, especially during dental procedures under anesthetic. With a brachycephalic dog who already has swallowing challenges, anesthesia is not something to take lightly. When he goes in for a dental procedure they have Dr. Fournier, Steph and Amanda involved (yep it’s a 3-person job!). They monitor him carefully, communicate back clearly, and treat him as if he were their own. They are the only team we trust.

Mariana at the front desk was the first person I met when I was exploring whether to switch clinics. She immediately set the tone for compassionate, respectful, and genuinely caring interactions. That first impression mattered more than she probably knows.

Switching vets was a no brainer. We are beyond grateful to have found a team that combines clinical excellence with true kindness. Georgie is in the best hands here. When so many clinics are being gobbled up by larger companies, My Animal is independently owned. Anybody who has felt like their pet was on a conveyor belt with some of these vets will know exactly what I am talking about. To the team; thank you.
very rude doctor

We just had our first appointment for our two cats Poutine and Perogie and it was an amazing experience. Everyone here truly loves animals and just want whats best for them. We felt no pressure or guilt, just excellent information and communication!
So happy we made the decision to move over, thank you My Animal Veterinary Clinic team!

I have nothing but good things to say about Dr Fournier and her team. I met Dr Fournier before she started her own practice and all I can say is she will go above and beyond for your pets. She has experience with dealing with pets with complex medical issues and is a great surgeon. Marianna, Steph, Felicia and Amanda are amazing. If you live in area, I would 100 percent say go to this clinic. I want to express my deepest gratitude to Dr Fournier and her team.

My Animal Veterinary Clinic at Mt. Pleasant & Eglinton in Toronto is truly a breath of fresh air.

At a time when many vet clinics in Toronto are quietly being bought up by large American and Canadian conglomerates, finding an independent practice has become incredibly difficult. I previously went to a wonderful vet that was eventually acquired by VCA—while the name stayed the same, the experience didn’t. Service declined, prices nearly tripled, and visits became frustrating and impersonal.

Walking into My Animal Veterinary Clinic is the complete opposite. You’re welcomed by genuinely kind, warm, and compassionate people. The vets and tech's are gentle, thorough, and take the time to explain everything clearly. Best of all—there’s no up sell, no pressure, just thoughtful recommendations and honest care.

Their fees are fair, the service is outstanding, and most importantly, my dog is truly cared for and loved by everyone there. If you’re looking for an independent vet in Toronto, I can’t recommend this clinic enough. They are amazing. 🐾
Thank you for the 5 stars!
Best clinic in town! Amazing staff, amazing service and you will feel like you have extended family in there!

Just wanted to share my experience at this veterinary clinic yesterday. Thank you so much to the kind and compassionate staff of this clinic for making mine and my cat's visit a successful one! From the front desk staff, the Doctor and other staff, everyone was just amazing and so supportive. I was blown away by their tender and understanding nature, as well as the treatment that was provided to my baby Mimi. She is a rescue and has been with me from the time she was 2 until now, a full grown 16 year old. She has been my trusty companion throughout the years but she is extremely scared of other people and animals. Just like mommy, Mimi experiences anxiety. This clinic understood her needs and provided her with the best care possible. I couldn't have asked for anything better. Today Mimi is happily spending time at home, resting, eating and receiving her ear cleaning and mousse treatments. Thank you again My Animal vet clinic!!
The receptionist was lovely and so sweet to my dog who had a lot of energy and was very anxious to be in a new environment. The vet was informative and kind as well.
the team who checked my cat in this clinic is very helpful and very professional. They also do phone call after few days to ask about my fur baby's condition. Thank you so much.

The whole team is very patient and caring, treating our pets like family. Our dog and cat have both received thoughtful and attentive care. The vet always explains medical terms clearly and in detail, which makes it easy for us as non-native speakers to understand. We feel very confident and grateful bringing our pets here. Highly recommend!
I have been bringing my dog, Jimmy, her since we moved back to Toronto. The whole team is amazing and I’m so appreciative of the care Jimmy has received. Thank you all!

I brought in my two new puppies for their first visit and was so impressed with the entire experience. From start to finish, the staff was warm, attentive, and genuinely caring. They made the appointment feel calm, positive, and even fun — not always easy with two energetic pups!

The thoughtful touches, like the adorable stuffie toys, were so appreciated. It’s clear this clinic is run with heart, and the love they have for their patients truly shows. I'm so glad to have found this wonderful veterinary team!

Highly recommend to anyone looking for thoughtful, loving care for their pets.

This clinic being a non-corporate entity is what attracted me to them and I'm so pleased I did since it provides continuity of care but Dr. Fournier and her staff were also exceptionally caring and friendly to me and my boys. The is definitely my new vet clinic.

We are so pleased to have a family oriented vet in our neighbourhood. Today our hybrid malshi, Ollie, had his first appointment with Dr. Fournier and it was such a positive experience. All the care and attention he received from Dr. Fournier, Marianna and Stephanie was so genuine and thorough. Thanks to our friends, who highly recommended the animal hospital, we have support nearby whenever it's needed. One good turn deserves another. It's our turn to suggest if you are looking for a vet for your special pet try My Animal Vetrinary Hospital -MAVC.
You won't be disappointed!

This Clinic is so lovely. It has a very clean aesthetic inside. And everyone takes very good care of you and your pet. On my first visit, they really took care to make sure that there wasn't another dog crossing pathways in the clinic with my dog. They're very aware of keeping things calm and protecting each dog from interacting with another dog, if needed. (This is necessary with my dog.). They kept her calm and were very conscious of her needs. We've been there a few times now and my dog is becoming more and more relaxed with them. In my opinion it has everything to do with their knowledge of how to interact with a dog like mine. I highly recommend this clinic. Friendly, clean, calm...it's perfect 😊 OH and they're very generous with their treats 🐕🐾
Thank you for your review, Seanna!

Dr. Fournier and her team were wonderful. Our first visit was such a pleasure. They took the time and extra care to really understand Chester's health needs and offer treatment that was well explained and demonstrated to ensure maximum effectiveness. We are so very pleased to have Chester under the care of Dr. Fournier and her team.

I rarely review places, only when they “wow” me.

The folks here are passionate at their jobs and are very well informed and professionally fun!

I’m so glad I hit a home run with this vet with my new dog. Excellent vet!

Ok given the lack of service, honesty, and quality of medical experience from nearby vet clinics. This place stands out..! Amazing vets, receptionist and service. The atmosphere is welcoming and stress-free. Their prices are matched with quality of service. I couldn't recommend them enough. They service all 4 of our pets. Luna, Leo, Coco and Mocha.

The staff at My Animal Veterinary Clinic are truly remarkable. From the very beginning, it was clear that this team doesn’t just care deeply for animals, they care just as deeply for the humans who love them.

We were originally with another veterinary clinic but were referred to MyAnimalVet when our cat needed urgent surgery to remove over 50 stones from his bladder. Dr. Fournier performed the surgery with incredible skill and care, and thanks to her and the team, our boy made a full recovery. The level of communication, compassion, and professionalism during that time made it easy for us to move all of our pet care over to them.

Sadly, our sweet boy recently passed away very unexpectedly. And once again, the MyAnimalVet team wrapped us in love. They handled everything with such tenderness, from allowing us precious time with him before saying goodbye to guiding us through aftercare options. They made space for our grief, offered comfort in our devastation, and treated our boy with so much love and respect.

Words cannot fully express just how special this team is. We will never, ever forget their kindness, their patience, their support, and the way they held us through one of the most heartbreaking experiences of our lives. They were, and will always be, part of our boy’s story- and now, forever, part of ours.

We had a very reassuring experience at My Animal Veterinary Clinic. Our pup Switch had just had a seizure and we were really anxious and scared. Everyone at the clinic was incredibly kind, professional, and supportive. They made us feel safe and took the time to explain everything clearly.

The vet was calm, gentle, and took the time to walk us through what might be going on and what the next steps could be. You could really feel how much she cares. From the front desk to the tech, everyone made a hard moment feel a lot less heavy.

If you're looking for a kind, caring vet clinic in Midtown Toronto, I’d absolutely recommend them. We're very grateful for the way they looked after our dog.

So far we've had amazing experiences with this veterinary. We got our first puppy, and we were really anxious pet parents. And they reassured us with their care.

They are a bit on the higher price point, but with the care we receive, we think it's worth it

In my years of owning dogs and going to vets I have never seen a dog get so excited to visit a vet (Dr Fournier), as our family dog Drax at My Animal Veterinary Clinic.  Equally I have never witnessed such a caring and patient vet, clearly Drax was a great judge of character!  The whole team at the clinic are amazing and emanate love for animals.   Nothing is too much trouble Dr Fournier, and she is enormously generous with her time.  Equally she always explains everything clearly and provides very balanced options to choose from, often recommending less expensive choices, especially if they might cause discomfort for the animal or fail to provide a conclusive diagnosis.  This team is incredible.
